versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֖י לֵוִ֑י גֵּרְשֹׁ֕ם קְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
controles.kjv: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Levi foram: Gérson, Coate, e Merari.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־גֵרְשׁ֖וֹם לִבְנִ֥י וְשִׁמְעִֽי׃

controles.web: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
controles.kjv: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
controles.livre: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Gérson: Libni, e Simei.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י קְהָ֑ת עַמְרָ֣ם וְיִצְהָ֔ר וְחֶבְר֖וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃

controles.web: The sons of Kohath were Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Coate: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom, e Uziel.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֥י מְרָרִ֖י מַחְלִ֣י וּמֻשִׁ֑י וְאֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת הַלֵּוִ֖י לַאֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
controles.kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Merari: Mali, e Musi. Estas são as famílias de Levi, segundo seus pais.

versos.hebraico: לְֽגֵרְשׁ֑וֹם לִבְנִ֥י בְנ֛וֹ יַ֥חַת בְּנ֖וֹ זִמָּ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
controles.kjv: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
controles.livre: De Gérson: seu filho Libni, seu filho Jaate, seu filho Zima.

versos.hebraico: יוֹאָ֤ח בְּנוֹ֙ עִדּ֣וֹ בְנ֔וֹ זֶ֥רַח בְּנ֖וֹ יְאָתְרַ֥י בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son.
controles.kjv: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
controles.livre: Seu filho Joabe, seu filho Ido, seu filho Zerá, e seu filho Jeaterai.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֖י קְהָ֑ת עַמִּינָדָ֣ב בְּנ֔וֹ קֹ֥רַח בְּנ֖וֹ אַסִּ֥יר בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
controles.kjv: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Coate foram: seu filho Aminadabe, seu filho Corá, seu filho Assir,

versos.hebraico: אֶלְקָנָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ וְאֶבְיָסָ֥ף בְּנ֖וֹ וְאַסִּ֥יר בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
controles.kjv: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
controles.livre: Seu filho Elcana, seu filho Ebiasafe, seu filho Assir,

versos.hebraico: תַּ֤חַת בְּנוֹ֙ אוּרִיאֵ֣ל בְּנ֔וֹ עֻזִּיָּ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ וְשָׁא֥וּל בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
controles.kjv: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
controles.livre: Seu filho Taate, seu filho Uriel, seu filho Uzias, e seu filho Saul.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵי֙ אֶלְקָנָ֔ה עֲמָשַׂ֖י וַאֲחִימֽוֹת׃

controles.web: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai, and Ahimoth.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
controles.livre: E os filhos Elcana foram: Amasai e Aimote.

versos.hebraico: אֶלְקָנָ֑ה בנו אֶלְקָנָ֔ה צוֹפַ֥י בְּנ֖וֹ וְנַ֥חַת בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
controles.kjv: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
controles.livre: Quanto a Elcana, os filhos de Elcana foram: seu filho Zofai, seu filho Naate,

versos.hebraico: אֱלִיאָ֥ב בְּנ֛וֹ יְרֹחָ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ אֶלְקָנָ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
controles.kjv: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
controles.livre: Seu filho Eliabe, seu filho Jeroão, e seu filho Elcana.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֧י שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל הַבְּכֹ֥ר וַשְׁנִ֖י וַאֲבִיָּֽה׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn Joel, and the second Abijah.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Samuel foram: o primogênito Vasni, e Abias.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֥י מְרָרִ֖י מַחְלִ֑י לִבְנִ֥י בְנ֛וֹ שִׁמְעִ֥י בְנ֖וֹ עֻזָּ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
controles.kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Merari: Mali, seu filho Libni, seu filho Simei, seu filho Uzá,

versos.hebraico: שִׁמְעָ֥א בְנ֛וֹ חַגִּיָּ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ עֲשָׂיָ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
controles.kjv: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
controles.livre: Seu filho Simeia, seu filho Hagias, e seu filho Asaías.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶעֱמִ֥יד דָּוִ֛יד עַל־יְדֵי־שִׁ֖יר בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה מִמְּנ֖וֹחַ הָאָרֽוֹן׃

controles.web: These are they whom David set over the service of song in Yahweh’s house, after that the ark had rest.
controles.kjv: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the Lord, after that the ark had rest.
controles.livre: Estes, pois, são os que Davi constituiu para o ofício da música da casa do Senhor, depois que a arca teve repouso.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֨וּ מְשָׁרְתִ֜ים לִפְנֵ֨י מִשְׁכַּ֤ן אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵד֙ בַּשִּׁ֔יר עַד־בְּנ֧וֹת שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיַּעַמְד֥וּ כְמִשְׁפָּטָ֖ם עַל־עֲבוֹדָתָֽם׃

controles.web: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, until Solomon had built Yahweh’s house in Jerusalem: and they waited on their office according to their order.
controles.kjv: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.
controles.livre: E eles serviam diante da tenda do tabernáculo da congregação com cânticos, até que Salomão edificou a casa do SENHOR em Jerusalém; e estiveram segundo seu costume em seu serviço.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֥לֶּה הָעֹמְדִ֖ים וּבְנֵיהֶ֑ם מִבְּנֵי֙ הַקְּהָתִ֔י הֵימָן֙ הַמְשׁוֹרֵ֔ר בֶּן־יוֹאֵ֖ל בֶּן־שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃

controles.web: These are those who waited, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
controles.kjv: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
controles.livre: Estes, pois, foram os que ali estavam com seus filhos: dos filhos dos coatitas, Hemã, o cantor, filho de Joel, filho de Samuel,

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־אֶלְקָנָה֙ בֶּן־יְרֹחָ֔ם בֶּן־אֱלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־תּֽוֹחַ׃

controles.web: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
controles.kjv: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
controles.livre: Filho de Elcana, filho de Jeroão, filho de Eliel, filho de Toá,

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־ציף בֶּן־אֶלְקָנָ֔ה בֶּן־מַ֖חַת בֶּן־עֲמָשָֽׂי׃

controles.web: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
controles.kjv: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
controles.livre: Filho de Zufe, filho de Elcana, filho Maate, filho de Amasai,

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־אֶלְקָנָה֙ בֶּן־יוֹאֵ֔ל בֶּן־עֲזַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־צְפַנְיָֽה׃

controles.web: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
controles.kjv: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
controles.livre: Filho de Elcana, filho de Joel, filho de Azarias, filho de Sofonias,

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־תַּ֨חַת֙ בֶּן־אַסִּ֔יר בֶּן־אֶבְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־קֹֽרַח׃

controles.web: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
controles.kjv: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
controles.livre: Filho de Taate, filho de Assir, filho de Ebiasafe, filho de Corá,

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־יִצְהָ֣ר בֶּן־קְהָ֔ת בֶּן־לֵוִ֖י בֶּן־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
controles.kjv: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
controles.livre: Filho de Izar, filho de Coate, filho de Levi, filho de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וְאָחִ֣יו אָסָ֔ף הָעֹמֵ֖ד עַל־יְמִינ֑וֹ אָסָ֥ף בֶּן־בֶּרֶכְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־שִׁמְעָֽא׃

controles.web: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
controles.kjv: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
controles.livre: E seu irmão Asafe estava à sua direita; Asafe era, filho de Berequias, filho de Simeia,

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־מִיכָאֵ֥ל בֶּן־בַּעֲשֵׂיָ֖ה בֶּן־מַלְכִּיָּֽה׃

controles.web: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
controles.kjv: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,
controles.livre: Filho de Micael, filho de Baaseias, filho de Malquias,

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־אֶתְנִ֥י בֶן־זֶ֖רַח בֶּן־עֲדָיָֽה׃

controles.web: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
controles.kjv: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
controles.livre: Filho de Etni, filho de Zerá, filho de Adaías,

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־אֵיתָ֥ן בֶּן־זִמָּ֖ה בֶּן־שִׁמְעִֽי׃

controles.web: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
controles.kjv: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
controles.livre: Filho de Etã, filho de Zima, filho de Simei;

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־יַ֥חַת בֶּן־גֵּרְשֹׁ֖ם בֶּן־לֵוִֽי׃ס

controles.web: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
controles.kjv: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
controles.livre: Filho de Jaate, filho de Gérson, filho de Levi.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֧י מְרָרִ֛י אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עַֽל־הַשְּׂמֹ֑אול אֵיתָן֙ בֶּן־קִישִׁ֔י בֶּן־עַבְדִּ֖י בֶּן־מַלּֽוּךְ׃

controles.web: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
controles.kjv: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
controles.livre: E seus irmãos, os filhos de Merari, estavam à esquerda; eram eles : Etã, filho de Quisi, filho de Abdi, filho de Maluque,

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָ֥ה בֶן־אֲמַצְיָ֖ה בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּֽה׃

controles.web: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
controles.kjv: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
controles.livre: Filho de Hasabias, filho de Amazias, filho de Hilquias,

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־אַמְצִ֥י בֶן־בָּנִ֖י בֶּן־שָֽׁמֶר׃

controles.web: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
controles.kjv: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
controles.livre: Filho de Anzi, filho de Bani, filho de Semer,

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־מַחְלִי֙ בֶּן־מוּשִׁ֔י בֶּן־מְרָרִ֖י בֶּן־לֵוִֽי׃ס

controles.web: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
controles.kjv: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
controles.livre: Filho de Mali, filho de Musi, filho de Merari, filho de Levi.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם הַלְוִיִּ֑ם נְתוּנִ֕ים לְכָ֨ל־עֲבוֹדַ֔ת מִשְׁכַּ֖ן בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.
controles.kjv: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
controles.livre: E seus irmãos, os Levitas, foram postos para todo o serviço do tabernáculo da casa de Deus.

versos.hebraico: וְֽאַהֲרֹ֨ן וּבָנָ֜יו מַקְטִירִ֨ים עַל־מִזְבַּ֤ח הָֽעוֹלָה֙ וְעַל־מִזְבַּ֣ח הַקְּטֹ֔רֶת לְכֹ֕ל מְלֶ֖אכֶת קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים וּלְכַפֵּר֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃פ

controles.web: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
controles.kjv: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
controles.livre: E Arão e seus filhos ofereciam incenso sobre o altar da oferta de queima, e sobre o altar do incenso, para toda a obra do lugar santíssimo, e para fazer expiação sobre Israel, conforme tudo quanto Moisés, servo de Deus, havia mandado.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בְּנ֛וֹ פִּֽינְחָ֥ס בְּנ֖וֹ אֲבִישׁ֥וּעַ בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
controles.kjv: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
controles.livre: E estes foram os filhos de Arão: seu filho Eleazar, seu filho Fineias, seu filho Abisua,

versos.hebraico: בֻּקִּ֥י בְנ֛וֹ עֻזִּ֥י בְנ֖וֹ זְרַֽחְיָ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
controles.kjv: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
controles.livre: Seu filho Buqui, seu filho Uzi, seu filho Zeraías,

versos.hebraico: מְרָי֥וֹת בְּנ֛וֹ אֲמַרְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ אֲחִיט֥וּב בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
controles.kjv: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
controles.livre: Seu filho Meraiote, seu filho Amarias, seu filho Aitube,

versos.hebraico: צָד֥וֹק בְּנ֖וֹ אֲחִימַ֥עַץ בְּנֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
controles.kjv: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
controles.livre: Seu filho Zadoque, e seu filho Aimaaz.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ מוֹשְׁבוֹתָ֔ם לְטִירוֹתָ֖ם בִּגְבוּלָ֑ם לִבְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ לְמִשְׁפַּחַ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֔י כִּ֥י לָהֶ֖ם הָיָ֥ה הַגּוֹרָֽל׃

controles.web: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),
controles.kjv: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
controles.livre: E estas foram suas habitações, conforme seus acampamentos e seus termos, dos filhos de Arão da família dos coatitas, porque eles foram sorteados.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיִּתְּנ֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם אֶת־חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֖יהָ סְבִיבֹתֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its suburbs around it;
controles.kjv: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
controles.livre: Deram-lhes, pois, a Hebrom na terra de Judá, e seus campos ao redor dela.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־שְׂדֵ֥ה הָעִ֖יר וְאֶת־חֲצֵרֶ֑יהָ נָתְנ֖וּ לְכָלֵ֥ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּֽה׃ס

controles.web: but the fields of the city, and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
controles.kjv: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
controles.livre: Porém o território da cidade e suas aldeias foram dadas a Calebe, filho de Jefoné.

versos.hebraico: וְלִבְנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן נָתְנוּ֙ אֶת־עָרֵ֣י הַמִּקְלָ֔ט אֶת־חֶבְר֥וֹן וְאֶת־לִבְנָ֖ה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־יַתִּ֥ר וְאֶֽת־אֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖עַ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

controles.web: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron; Libnah also with its suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
controles.livre: E aos filhos de Arão deram as seguintes cidades de refúgio: Hebrom, e Libna com seus campos; Jathir e Estemoa com seus campos;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־חִילֵז֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ אֶת־דְּבִ֖יר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

controles.web: and Hilen with its suburbs, Debir with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,
controles.livre: Hilém com seus campos; Debir com seus campos;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־עָשָׁן֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־בֵּ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ס

controles.web: and Ashan with its suburbs, and Beth Shemesh with its suburbs;
controles.kjv: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Beth–shemesh with her suburbs:
controles.livre: Asã com seus campos; e a Bete-Semes com seus campos;

versos.hebraico: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֗ן אֶת־גֶּ֤בַע וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֨יהָ֙ וְאֶת־עָלֶ֣מֶת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־עֲנָת֖וֹת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ כָּל־עָרֵיהֶ֛ם שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עִ֖יר בְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its suburbs, and Allemeth with its suburbs, and Anathoth with its suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
controles.kjv: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
controles.livre: E da tribo de Benjamim, a Geba com seus campos; Alemete com seus campos; e Anatote com seus campos. Todas as suas cidades, repartidas por suas famílias, foram treze cidades.

versos.hebraico: וְלִבְנֵ֨י קְהָ֜ת הַנּוֹתָרִ֗ים מִמִּשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַמַּטֶּ֡ה מִֽ֠מַּחֲצִית מַטֵּ֨ה חֲצִ֧י מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה בַּגּוֹרָ֖ל עָרִ֥ים עָֽשֶׂר׃ס

controles.web: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
controles.kjv: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
controles.livre: Mas aos filhos de Coate, que restaram da família daquela tribo, deram por sorteio dez cidades da meia tribo de Manassés.

versos.hebraico: וְלִבְנֵ֨י גֵרְשׁ֜וֹם לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֣ה יִ֠שָׂשכָר וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה אָשֵׁ֜ר וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י וּמִמַּטֵּ֤ה מְנַשֶּׁה֙ בַּבָּשָׁ֔ן עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ס

controles.web: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
controles.kjv: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
controles.livre: E aos filhos de Gérson, segundo suas famílias, deram treze cidades da tribo de Issacar, da tribo de Aser, da tribo de Naftali, e da tribo de Manassés, em Basã.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֨י מְרָרִ֜י לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֣ה רְ֠אוּבֵן וּֽמִמַּטֵּה־גָ֞ד וּמִמַּטֵּ֤ה זְבוּלֻן֙ בַּגּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃

controles.web: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
controles.kjv: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
controles.livre: E aos filhos de Merari, segundo suas famílias, deram por sorteio doze cidades da tribo de Rúben, da tribo de Gade, e da tribo de Zebulom.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַלְוִיִּ֑ם אֶת־הֶעָרִ֖ים וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their suburbs.
controles.kjv: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.
controles.livre: Assim os filhos de Israel deram aos Levitas estas cidades com seus campos.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ בַגּוֹרָ֗ל מִמַּטֵּ֤ה בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה֙ וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה בְנֵי־שִׁמְע֔וֹן וּמִמַּטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן אֵ֚ת הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרְא֥וּ אֶתְהֶ֖ם בְּשֵׁמֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
controles.kjv: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.
controles.livre: E deram-lhes por sorteio, da tribo dos filhos de Judá, da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, e da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim, estas cidades, as quais mencionaram por seus nomes.

versos.hebraico: וּמִֽמִּשְׁפְּח֖וֹת בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֑ת וַיְהִי֙ עָרֵ֣י גְבוּלָ֔ם מִמַּטֵּ֖ה אֶפְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
controles.kjv: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
controles.livre: E quanto ao resto das famílias dos filhos de Coate deram-lhes cidades com seus termos da tribo de Efraim.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם אֶת־עָרֵ֧י הַמִּקְלָ֛ט אֶת־שְׁכֶ֥ם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֖יהָ בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־גֶּ֖זֶר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

controles.web: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its suburbs; Gezer also with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
controles.livre: E deram-lhes das cidades de refúgio, a Siquém e seus campos nas montanhas de Efraim, e a Gezer com seus campos,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶֽת־יָקְמְעָם֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־בֵּ֥ית חוֹר֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

controles.web: and Jokmeam with its suburbs, and Beth Horon with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Beth–horon with her suburbs,
controles.livre: A Jocmeão com seus campos, a Bete-Horom com seus campos,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־אַיָּלוֹן֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־גַּת־רִמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃פ

controles.web: and Aijalon with its suburbs, and Gath Rimmon with its suburbs;
controles.kjv: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gath–rimmon with her suburbs:
controles.livre: A Aijalom com seus campos, e a Gate-Rimom com seus campos;

versos.hebraico: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִית֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת־עָנֵר֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־בִּלְעָ֖ם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ לְמִשְׁפַּ֥חַת לִבְנֵי־קְהָ֖ת הַנּוֹתָרִֽים׃פ

controles.web: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its suburbs, and Bileam with its suburbs, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
controles.kjv: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
controles.livre: Da meia tribo de Manassés, a Aner com seus campos, e a Bileã com seus campos, para os que restaram da família dos filhos de Coate.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵי֮ גֵּרְשׁוֹם֒ מִמִּשְׁפַּ֗חַת חֲצִי֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת־גּוֹלָ֥ן בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־עַשְׁתָּר֖וֹת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ס

controles.web: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its suburbs, and Ashtaroth with its suburbs;
controles.kjv: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
controles.livre: Aos filhos de Gérson deram da família da meia tribo de Manassés, a Golã em Basã com seus campos e a Astarote com seus campos;

versos.hebraico: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה יִשָׂשכָ֔ר אֶת־קֶ֖דֶשׁ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ אֶת־דָּבְרַ֖ת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

controles.web: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its suburbs, Daberath with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
controles.livre: E da tribo de Issacar, a Quedes com seus campos, a Daberate com seus campos,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־רָאמוֹת֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־עָנֵ֖ם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ס

controles.web: and Ramoth with its suburbs, and Anem with its suburbs;
controles.kjv: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:
controles.livre: A Ramote com seus campos, e a Aném com seus campos;

versos.hebraico: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֔ר אֶת־מָשָׁ֖ל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־עַבְדּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

controles.web: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its suburbs, and Abdon with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,
controles.livre: E da tribo de Aser a Masal com seus campos, a Abdom com seus campos,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־חוּקֹק֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־רְחֹ֖ב וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

controles.web: and Hukok with its suburbs, and Rehob with its suburbs;
controles.kjv: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:
controles.livre: A Hucoque com seus campos, e a Reobe com seus campos.

versos.hebraico: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י אֶת־קֶ֤דֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־חַמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־קִרְיָתַ֖יִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ס

controles.web: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its suburbs, and Hammon with its suburbs, and Kiriathaim with its suburbs.
controles.kjv: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.
controles.livre: E da tribo de Naftali, a Quedes na Galileia com seus campos, a Hamom com seus campos, e a Quiriataim com seus campos.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֣י מְרָרִי֮ הַנּוֹתָרִים֒ מִמַּטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן אֶת־רִמּוֹנ֖וֹ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ אֶת־תָּב֖וֹר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

controles.web: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its suburbs, Tabor with its suburbs;
controles.kjv: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:
controles.livre: E aos que restaram dos filhos de Merari, deram da tribo de Zebulom, a Rimono com seus campos, e a Tabor com seus campos;

versos.hebraico: וּמֵעֵ֜בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֣ן יְרֵחוֹ֮ לְמִזְרַ֣ח הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ מִמַּטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶת־בֶּ֥צֶר בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־יַ֖הְצָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

controles.web: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them, out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with its suburbs, and Jahzah with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
controles.livre: E dalém do Jordão de Jericó, ao oriente do Jordão, deram da tribo de Rúben, a Bezer no deserto com seus campos; a Jaza com seus campos.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־קְדֵמוֹת֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־מֵיפַ֖עַת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

controles.web: and Kedemoth with its suburbs, and Mephaath with its suburbs;
controles.kjv: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:
controles.livre: A Quedemote com seus campos, e a Mefaate com seus campos;

versos.hebraico: וּמִ֨מַּטֵּה־גָ֔ד אֶת־רָאמ֥וֹת בַּגִּלְעָ֖ד וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶֽת־מַחֲנַ֖יִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

controles.web: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its suburbs, and Mahanaim with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
controles.livre: E da tribo de Gade, a Ramote em Gileade com seus campos, a Maanaim com seus campos,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־חֶשְׁבּוֹן֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־יַעְזֵ֖יר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ס

controles.web: and Heshbon with its suburbs, and Jazer with its suburbs.
controles.kjv: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.
controles.livre: A Hesbom com seus campos, e a Jazer com seus campos.
